clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding dimensions,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding dimensions, weight and strength for wood wool building slabs.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types a) Type 1- Light weight slabs, intended for nonload bearing  partitions, ceilings, wall linings, permanent   shuttering and roof insulation. b) Type 2-  Heavy duty slabs, intended for load bearing situations and for use in roof construction.

clauses.title: Form and Texture –
clauses.text: 3. Form and Texture - Slabs  shall be uniform thickness   with rectangular parallel faces and  shall have clean reasonable square edges and  shall be of uniform  texture.
